verdict.rationale: A keyless GET to the GOV.UK Content API returned HTTP 200 with a JSON body for a business-setup guidance page. Companies House's own guidance and developer pages yielded quoted text (gov.uk organisation page, developer-specs guides, find-and-update), which suggests they are readable without a bot wall. However, no probe directly tests a Companies House guidance page with an identified user agent, and the keyless 401 on the REST API is an auth model, not evidence about the reading surface. Missing for 10: a direct status probe of Companies House guidance and developer-doc pages with an identified UA, explicit confirmation of no CAPTCHA, JS-only shell or bot challenge, and independent hands-on corroboration.
